New features tested: Weather (Open-Meteo), News (RSS feeds), Calendar (local MongoDB), Smart Home (mock simulation with 8 devices and 4 scenes), Skills Marketplace (10 skills with install/uninstall).

rca_of_issue.issue: Smart Home scene activation tests failing (4 tests)
rca_of_issue.root_cause: The POST /api/smart-home/scene endpoint was defined with scene: str = '' parameter, which FastAPI interprets as a query parameter. However, the frontend and tests were sending scene as JSON body.
reproduction_steps: 1. Send POST request to /api/smart-home/scene with JSON body {"scene": "morning"}
2. Backend receives empty string for scene parameter
rca_of_issue.mitigation_applied: Added SceneActivation Pydantic model with scene: str field. Updated endpoint to accept req: SceneActivation parameter. Now properly accepts JSON body and extracts scene value.
rca_of_issue.verification: After fix, all 4 scene tests passed. Frontend scene activation also working correctly.
